# Single-file HTML canvas games

Follow these conventions when you build a browser game in one HTML file.

## Structure
- One `index.html` with inline `<style>` and one inline `<script>`; no external libraries or assets.
- A single `<canvas>` sized with CSS to fit the window while keeping its aspect ratio; draw at a fixed logical resolution (for example 800x600) and scale.
- Keep the code in this order: constants, state, input, update, draw, game loop, start.

## Game loop
- Drive the loop with `requestAnimationFrame` and a delta time in seconds, clamped to 1/30 s so a background tab does not make objects jump.
- Keep `update(dt)` and `draw()` separate; never draw inside update.
- Use a small state machine: `title`, `playing`, `levelClear`, `gameOver`, `win`.

## Input
- Keyboard: arrow keys and A/D to move, Space or Enter to start, launch and restart. Track pressed keys in a set on `keydown`/`keyup` and call `preventDefault()` for the arrow keys and Space.
- Mouse: move the paddle or player with `mousemove` using the canvas bounding rectangle; click to start or launch.
- Touch: mirror the mouse handlers with `touchstart`/`touchmove` and `{ passive: false }`.

## Gameplay details
- Store levels as arrays of strings, one character per brick or tile, so a level is easy to read and edit.
- Show score, lives and level in a HUD drawn on the canvas.
- Give the player a short pause and a message between levels and after losing a life.
- Make collisions robust: move in small steps or resolve along the axis of least penetration so fast objects do not tunnel.

## Finish
- Check that the file opens without console errors and that every state can be reached.
- Keep the file under about 600 lines.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #0b0e1a; overflow: hidden; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    height: min(100vh, calc(100vw * 3 / 4));
    background: #111629;
    cursor: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ---------- Constants ----------
const W = 800, H = 600;
const HUD_H = 40;
const PADDLE_W = 110, PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40, PADDLE_SPEED = 600;
const BALL_R = 8;
const BRICK_W = 70, BRICK_H = 24, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = 80;
const START_LIVES = 3;
const PAUSE_TIME = 1.5;

// Level legend: '.' empty, '1' one-hit, '2' two-hit, '3' three-hit
const LEVELS = [
  {
    speed: 340,
    rows: [
      "1111111111",
      "1111111111",
      "1122222211",
      "1111111111",
      "1111111111",
    ],
  },
  {
    speed: 410,
    rows: [
      "3.3.33.3.3",
      "2222222222",
      "2.1111111.2".slice(0, 10),
      "1213113121",
      "22.2222.22",
      "1111111111",
    ],
  },
];

const BRICK_COLORS = { 1: "#4fc3f7", 2: "#ffb74d", 3: "#e57373" };

// ---------- State ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let state = "title"; // title, playing, levelClear, gameOver, win
let score = 0, lives = START_LIVES, levelIndex = 0;
let bricks = [];
let paddle = { x: W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H };
let ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true };
let message = "";
let pauseTimer = 0;
let mouseX = null;

function loadLevel(i) {
  bricks = [];
  const rows = LEVELS[i].rows;
  const cols = rows[0].length;
  const totalW = cols * BRICK_W + (cols - 1) * BRICK_GAP;
  const left = (W - totalW) / 2;
  rows.forEach((row, r) => {
    [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const hp = parseInt(ch, 10);
      if (!hp) return;
      bricks.push({
        x: left + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
        y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
        w: BRICK_W, h: BRICK_H, hp, maxHp: hp,
      });
    });
  });
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
  ball.stuck = true;
  ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 1;
}

function newGame() {
  score = 0; lives = START_LIVES; levelIndex = 0;
  loadLevel(0);
  state = "playing";
}

function launchBall() {
  if (!ball.stuck) return;
  const speed = LEVELS[levelIndex].speed;
  const angle = (-Math.PI / 2) + (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3);
  ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
  ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
  ball.stuck = false;
}

// ---------- Input ----------
const keys = new Set();

function primaryAction() {
  if (state === "title" || state === "gameOver" || state === "win") {
    newGame();
  } else if (state === "playing" && pauseTimer <= 0) {
    launchBall();
  }
}

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase());
  if ((e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") && !e.repeat) primaryAction();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));
window.addEventListener("blur", () => keys.clear());

function pointerToCanvasX(clientX) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => { mouseX = pointerToCanvasX(e.clientX); });
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { mouseX = pointerToCanvasX(e.clientX); primaryAction(); });
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  mouseX = pointerToCanvasX(e.touches[0].clientX);
  primaryAction();
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  mouseX = pointerToCanvasX(e.touches[0].clientX);
}, { passive: false });

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (state === "levelClear") {
    pauseTimer -= dt;
    if (pauseTimer <= 0) {
      levelIndex++;
      loadLevel(levelIndex);
      state = "playing";
    }
    return;
  }
  if (state !== "playing") return;

  if (pauseTimer > 0) pauseTimer -= dt;

  // Paddle movement: keyboard takes priority while held, otherwise follow mouse
  let dir = 0;
  if (keys.has("arrowleft") || keys.has("a")) dir -= 1;
  if (keys.has("arrowright") || keys.has("d")) dir += 1;
  if (dir !== 0) {
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
    mouseX = null;
  } else if (mouseX !== null) {
    paddle.x = mouseX - paddle.w / 2;
  }
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

  if (ball.stuck) {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 1;
    return;
  }

  // Sub-step movement so fast balls don't tunnel through bricks
  const dist = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt;
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / (BALL_R * 0.5)));
  const sdt = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (stepBall(sdt)) break;
  }
}

// Returns true if the step ended the ball's flight (life lost / level cleared)
function stepBall(dt) {
  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

  // Walls
  if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) { ball.x = BALL_R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) { ball.x = W - BALL_R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - BALL_R < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Fell out
  if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = "gameOver";
    } else {
      message = "Life lost!";
      pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME;
      resetBall();
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + BALL_R >= paddle.y && ball.y - BALL_R <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - BALL_R && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + BALL_R) {
    const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
    const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * (Math.PI / 3);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R;
  }

  // Bricks: resolve along axis of least penetration
  for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
    const b = bricks[i];
    const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
    const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

    const overlapL = ball.x + BALL_R - b.x;
    const overlapR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - BALL_R);
    const overlapT = ball.y + BALL_R - b.y;
    const overlapB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - BALL_R);
    const minX = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
    const minY = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
    if (minX < minY) {
      if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    } else {
      if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    }

    b.hp--;
    score += 10;
    if (b.hp <= 0) {
      score += 40 * b.maxHp;
      bricks.splice(i, 1);
    }
    if (bricks.length === 0) {
      score += 100 * lives;
      if (levelIndex + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
        state = "levelClear";
        pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME + 0.5;
      } else {
        state = "win";
      }
      return true;
    }
    break; // one brick per step
  }
  return false;
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function drawRoundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function centerText(text, y, size, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color || "#fff";
  ctx.font = `bold ${size}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1b2240";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.font = "bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 16, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(`Level ${levelIndex + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Lives: ", W - 16 - START_LIVES * 20, HUD_H / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? "#ff5370" : "#3a4166";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 16 - (START_LIVES - 1 - i) * 20 - 7, HUD_H / 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawGame() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    ctx.fillStyle = BRICK_COLORS[b.hp];
    ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.75 : 1;
    drawRoundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#e0e6ff";
  drawRoundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function overlay() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#111629";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === "title") {
    centerText("BRICK BREAKER", H / 2 - 80, 56, "#4fc3f7");
    centerText("Move: Mouse or Arrow keys / A, D", H / 2, 22);
    centerText("Launch: Click, Space or Enter", H / 2 + 34, 22);
    centerText("Click or press Space to start", H / 2 + 100, 24, "#ffb74d");
    return;
  }

  drawGame();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === "playing") {
    if (pauseTimer > 0) {
      centerText(message, H / 2 + 40, 36, "#ff5370");
    } else if (ball.stuck) {
      centerText("Click or press Space to launch", H / 2 + 60, 22, "#ccd");
    }
  } else if (state === "levelClear") {
    overlay();
    centerText(`Level ${levelIndex + 1} cleared!`, H / 2 - 20, 44, "#81c784");
    centerText(`Get ready for level ${levelIndex + 2}`, H / 2 + 30, 22);
  } else if (state === "gameOver") {
    overlay();
    centerText("GAME OVER", H / 2 - 30, 56, "#ff5370");
    centerText(`Final score: ${score}`, H / 2 + 25, 26);
    centerText("Click or press Space to play again", H / 2 + 70, 22, "#ffb74d");
  } else if (state === "win") {
    overlay();
    centerText("YOU WIN!", H / 2 - 30, 56, "#81c784");
    centerText(`Final score: ${score}`, H / 2 + 25, 26);
    centerText("Click or press Space to play again", H / 2 + 70, 22, "#ffb74d");
  }
}

// ---------- Game loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- Start ----------
loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  mouseX = pointerToCanvasX(e.touches[0].clientX);
}, { passive: false });

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (state === "levelClear") {
    pauseTimer -= dt;
    if (pauseTimer <= 0) {
      levelIndex++;
      loadLevel(levelIndex);
      state = "playing";
    }
    return;
  }
  if (state !== "playing") return;

  if (pauseTimer > 0) pauseTimer -= dt;

  // Paddle movement: keyboard takes priority while held, otherwise follow mouse
  let dir = 0;
  if (keys.has("arrowleft") || keys.has("a")) dir -= 1;
  if (keys.has("arrowright") || keys.has("d")) dir += 1;
  if (dir !== 0) {
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
    mouseX = null;
  } else if (mouseX !== null) {
    paddle.x = mouseX - paddle.w / 2;
  }
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

  if (ball.stuck) {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 1;
    return;
  }

  // Sub-step movement so fast balls don't tunnel through bricks
  const dist = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt;
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / (BALL_R * 0.5)));
  const sdt = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (stepBall(sdt)) break;
  }
}

// Returns true if the step ended the ball's flight (life lost / level cleared)
function stepBall(dt) {
  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

  // Walls
  if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) { ball.x = BALL_R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) { ball.x = W - BALL_R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - BALL_R < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Fell out
  if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = "gameOver";
    } else {
      message = "Life lost!";
      pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME;
      resetBall();
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + BALL_R >= paddle.y && ball.y - BALL_R <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - BALL_R && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + BALL_R) {
    const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
    const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * (Math.PI / 3);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R;
  }

  // Bricks: resolve along axis of least penetration
  for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
    const b = bricks[i];
    const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
    const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

    const overlapL = ball.x + BALL_R - b.x;
    const overlapR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - BALL_R);
    const overlapT = ball.y + BALL_R - b.y;
    const overlapB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - BALL_R);
    const minX = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
    const minY = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
    if (minX < minY) {
      if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    } else {
      if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    }

    b.hp--;
    score += 10;
    if (b.hp <= 0) {
      score += 40 * b.maxHp;
      bricks.splice(i, 1);
    }
    if (bricks.length === 0) {
      score += 100 * lives;
      if (levelIndex + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
        state = "levelClear";
        pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME + 0.5;
      } else {
        state = "win";
      }
      return true;
    }
    break; // one brick per step
  }
  return false;
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function drawRoundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function centerText(text, y, size, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color || "#fff";
  ctx.font = `bold ${size}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1b2240";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.font = "bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 16, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(`Level ${levelIndex + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Lives: ", W - 16 - START_LIVES * 20, HUD_H / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? "#ff5370" : "#3a4166";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 16 - (START_LIVES - 1 - i) * 20 - 7, HUD_H / 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawGame() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    ctx.fillStyle = BRICK_COLORS[b.hp];
    ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.75 : 1;
    drawRoundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#e0e6ff";
  drawRoundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function overlay() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#111629";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === "title") {
    centerText("BRICK BREAKER", H / 2 - 80, 56, "#4fc3f7");
    centerText("Move: Mouse or Arrow keys / A, D", H / 2, 22);
    centerText("Launch: Click, Space or Enter", H / 2 + 34, 22);
    centerText("Click or press Space to start", H / 2 + 100, 24, "#ffb74d");
    return;
  }

  drawGame();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === "playing") {
    if (pauseTimer > 0) {
      centerText(message, H / 2 + 40, 36, "#ff5370");
    } else if (ball.stuck) {
      centerText("Click or press Space to launch", H / 2 + 60, 22, "#ccd");
    }
  } else if (state === "levelClear") {
    overlay();
    centerText(`Level ${levelIndex + 1} cleared!`, H / 2 - 20, 44, "#81c784");
    centerText(`Get ready for level ${levelIndex + 2}`, H / 2 + 30, 22);
  } else if (state === "gameOver") {
    overlay();
    centerText("GAME OVER", H / 2 - 30, 56, "#ff5370");
    centerText(`Final score: ${score}`, H / 2 + 25, 26);
    centerText("Click or press Space to play again", H / 2 + 70, 22, "#ffb74d");
  } else if (state === "win") {
    overlay();
    centerText("YOU WIN!", H / 2 - 30, 56, "#81c784");
    centerText(`Final score: ${score}`, H / 2 + 25, 26);
    centerText("Click or press Space to play again", H / 2 + 70, 22, "#ffb74d");
  }
}

// ---------- Game loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- Start ----------
loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

I've written the brick-breaker game to `index.html`. I didn't open it in a browser, and I couldn't syntax-check the script because the check command wasn't approved, so it hasn't been run yet.

- **Mouse:** moving the mouse moves the paddle, and clicking starts or launches. Touch screens work the same way.
